segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation, redness or dryness, though several recommend starting at a reduced frequency or shorter leave-on time rather than the full 5-day protocol; only one sensitive-skin reviewer found she could not tolerate more than 3 consecutive days before cutting back.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who is also sensitive, report the peel feels nourishing rather than drying and helped smooth dry, flaky patches while their dark spots faded.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the peel does not dry out their skin, with some describing it as nourishing or resolving flakiness and dullness; one reviewer, however, reports it dried her skin out significantly with no improvement in her hyperpigmentation to show for it.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no redness and describe calmer, less inflamed-looking skin after use; one reviewer's face turned red and burned, though she attributes this to combining the peel with a different face wash rather than the peel on its own.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma or post-acne marks within one to a few weeks of consistent use, including on longstanding pregnancy-related and sun-related discoloration; a notable minority, including several who used it for two or more weeks, report no visible change at all, and one reviewer says her single darkest mark stayed visible even as her lighter marks faded.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report fewer whiteheads or blemish marks with regular use; dissent includes one reviewer who broke out badly after starting and another who saw new whiteheads appear when following the full daily 5-day protocol, an issue that resolved once she cut back to 1-2 times a week.

aspects.libelle: Milder tingle than expected for an at-home peel
Can burn if combined with other active ingredients
Full 5-day protocol too intense for some
Lightweight, creamy texture, easy to apply
Increases sun sensitivity, needs daily SPF
